mask_roms.source: tools/fetch-rom-elfs.sh roms (espressif/esp-rom-elfs, pinned by SHA-256 in the script)

firmware.sketch: docs/evidence/nat-transport/wifi-net-probe.ino (EX258), the same build as EX258's inputs.json
firmware.not_committed: A plain Arduino build of the sketch; not added to the repository.

runs.page: node docs/evidence/nat-relay/nat-relay-run.mjs web/wasm/esp32sim.wasm roms/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf bootloader.bin partitions.bin wifi-net.bin 40, with the module from tools/wasm-build.sh, on a desktop with internet access; runs/page.txt is its output (UART0 and the relay's counts)
runs.cli: esp32sim --rom roms/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf --boot rom --board none --flash-mb 4 --bootloader bootloader.bin --ptable partitions.bin --app wifi-net.bin --wifi ssid=esp32sim --net nat --console uart0 --max-seconds 40 --no-dump, built from this branch, with etc/resolv.conf (nameserver 8.8.8.8) under the run's current drive; runs/cli.txt is UART0 and the net / nat report lines
